preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code; distinguish supplied evidence from inference.

premises-and-terms.instruction: Identify the proposed conclusion and actual premises. For P implies Q, with Q false conclude P false; with Q true, P is unknown. Keep these verdicts separate. Do not attribute any extra premise to the source.

quantifier-scope.instruction: Retain universal/particular scope, negation, modality, and existence assumptions when formalizing.

validity-separate-support.instruction: Ask whether the conclusion follows if the premises hold, then separately assess support for those premises.

countermodel-check.instruction: For each inference, give an explicit valid relation or exhibit a particular situation where all premises hold and the proposed conclusion fails. Naming a converse without such a witness is incomplete.
